name: fig_intercept_error.jpg
caption: Recorded mean squared error across three intercept corrections. Values correspond to one deterministic calculation evaluated on the same five observations used to determine the correction (b = 3), with no stochastic repetitions, optimizer, external dataset, held-out evaluation, uncertainty intervals, or interpolated values.

name: fig_residual_workflow.jpg
caption: Schematic of the residual-based intercept correction workflow on five synthetic observations. Baseline predictions 2x and observed targets y determine the residuals r_i, from which the mean correction b = 3 is computed. Adding this scalar offset produces corrected predictions 2x + b, which evaluate to zero residual error on the original data. The dashed path highlights the reuse of the five observations, underscoring that this procedure represents an exact finite arithmetic verification rather than predictive generalization.
